capabilities._note: Text and a length only: no bpm, section or lyrics input, so a cue's arc is told as a story (prompt.py) and its tempo is written in the text. Measured on local ComfyUI 2026-11-01 (docs/SOUND.md 'Measured: Stable Audio 3 Medium'): an arc told as a story put the climax in place 6 of 8 seeds, the climax 18 dB over the intro, shape error median 0.36; a tempo in the text held within 0.5 % at 72 and 120 bpm, 4-7 % off at 92 (with a pulse). About 2 s a 52 s cue on an RTX 5090. Instrumental only. A theme (a cue's leitmotif) is rendered from: its sound, reshaped to the cue's tempo and bars, is the latent the sampler starts from at a strength (where the schedule starts, t0; 0.86 by default: docs/SOUND.md 'Measured: leitmotifs', 'A theme take under another length and tempo'), so the tune recurs in the cue's own instruments.

template._note: Seconds, as EmptyLatentAudio takes them (up to 6:20).

binding._note: ComfyUI's audio_stable_audio_3_medium template without its optional Qwen reprompt (seriesmith writes the prompt): CheckpointLoaderSimple (model and VAE), the T5Gemma text encoder through CLIPLoader type stable_audio, EmptyLatentAudio in seconds, KSampler at 8 steps, cfg 1, lcm / simple, VAEDecodeAudio, SaveAudio (flac; the take is converted to wav when it comes back).
